```{r}
library(grateful) # for citations!
library("tidyverse")

# Load in dat_open
dat_open <- read_csv("dat_open.csv")
```

```{r}
#Creating a dataset to do qual analysis with

dat_filtered <- dat_open %>%
  filter(Question != "Progress") %>%
  filter(Question != "Finished") %>%
  filter(Question != "Status") %>%
  filter(Question != "DistributionChannel") %>%
  filter(Question != "UserLanguage") %>%
  filter(Question != "consent_form") %>%
  filter(Question != "RecordedDate") %>%
  filter(Question != "RecordedDate") %>%
  filter(Question != "followup_interested") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Answer), Answer != "") %>%
  filter(Question != "academic_frequency") %>%
  filter(Question != "nonacademic_frequenc") %>%
  select(-Recruitment) %>% #dropping Recruitment column
  mutate(Pseudonym = factor(ResponseId)) %>%              # convert to factor
  mutate(Pseudonym = paste0("Participant_", as.numeric(Pseudonym))) %>% 
  select(Pseudonym, everything()) #giving each participant a number as a pseudonym

#Checking for amount of unique questions
unique_questions <- dat_filtered %>%
  distinct(Question)

#Duplicate question for Prolific IDs spotted
duplicate_filtered <- dat_filtered %>%
  filter(Question %in% c("PROLIFIC_PID", "Q29"))

#Checking for differences in Prolific ID rows
dat_flagged <- duplicate_filtered %>%
  group_by(Answer) %>%
  mutate(is_unique = n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

#Dropping duplicate Q29 row from main dataset
dat_filtered_2 <- dat_filtered %>%
  filter(Question != "Q29")

#Checking for amount of unique questions in new dataset
unique_questions <- dat_filtered_2 %>%
  distinct(Question)
```

```{r}
#Creating a csv of demographics answers
demos <- dat_filtered_2 %>%
  filter(Question %in% c("StartDate", "EndDate", "Duration (in seconds)", "age", "gender", "position", "neurodivergent", "neurodivergent_1_TEXT", "ethnicity", "ethnicity_22_TEXT", "Response_Sharing_Cho", "ND screener", "Screener - Country", "Age Screener", "PROLIFIC_PID", "ethnicity_11_TEXT"))

write.csv(demos, "demos.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Creating csv files of open answers
# Filter and select relevant columns for creating csv files
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)

dat_csvs <- dat_filtered_2 %>%
  select(-ResponseId) %>%
  select(Question, Pseudonym, Answer)

# List of questions to export
questions <- c("other_tools", "name_faves", "what_tasks", "struggles", "benefits_academic", "useful", "barriers",                "tasks_activities", "ND_AI_use", "other_uses_guidance", "anything_else")

# Write each question subset to its own CSV
walk(questions, function(q) {
  dat_csvs %>%
    filter(Question == q) %>%
    write_csv(paste0(q, ".csv"))
})
```

```{r}
##Creating a workbook of csv files
#install.packages("openxlsx")
library(openxlsx)

# Your folder with the CSV files
csv_folder <- "Open_Answer_Files"

# Specify only the CSV files you want to include
selected_files <- c(
  "name_faves.csv",
  "barriers.csv",
  "anything_else.csv",
  "benefits_academic.csv",
  "ND_AI_use.csv",
  "other_tools.csv",
  "other_uses_guidance.csv",
  "struggles.csv",
  "tasks_activities.csv",
  "useful.csv",
  "what_tasks.csv",
  "demos.csv")

# Create full paths to those CSVs
csv_paths <- file.path(csv_folder, selected_files)

# Create a new Excel workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Loop through selected CSVs and add each as a worksheet
for (file in csv_paths) {
  sheet_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  data <- read.csv(file)

  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

  # Write your extra row (as a message, label, or just empty)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = paste("Data from", sheet_name), startRow = 1, colNames = FALSE)

  # Then write the actual data below it (starting at row 2)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = data, startRow = 2)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "selected_questions.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

```
